Subject: Renewal: proposed reserved + staged rollout for added GPU capacity

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. As discussed, we put together a short proposal to extend your Dedicated contract for 12 months and add a dedicated reserved pool: +40 T4x-equivalent GPUs (configured as two 20-GPU slices for redundancy). Key asks from your side were: predictable throughput for peak batch jobs and minimal disruption during cutover.

High-level commercial changes:
- Term: 12 months (auto-renew unless notice)
- Added reserved capacity: 40 GPUs (split into Pool-A and Pool-B)
- Throughput SLAs: baseline token throughput guaranty for Pool-A at 85% of current peak; burst policy for Pool-B for 1-hour daily peaks
- Pricing: incremental reserved fee + per-token usage floor (see attached Fintab_Renewal_Proposal_v2.pdf)

Operational rollout (staged):
1) Pre-provision & validation (week -2): spin up Pool-A and Pool-B, run internal perf validation on sample workloads.
2) Canary window (week -1): route 5% of live traffic to Pool-A for 48 hours with enhanced monitoring.
3) Incremental shift (day 0-3 after go): 25% -> 50% -> 100% depending on canary health signals. Pool-B stays cold-warm for bursts and failover.
4) Post-cutover stabilization (week +1): adjust autoscaling thresholds and KV-cache priming.

We included a detailed staged_rollout_config.csv and a monitoring/checklist doc to instrument the canary. Would you be comfortable with the proposed 5% canary and the 48h window, or do you prefer a longer validation? Also please confirm preferred maintenance windows (we recommend a 2-hour window in your low-traffic UTC-8 evenings).

If this looks good I’ll loop in Marcus (ops lead for Dedicated) and Rishi (account exec) to lock dates and sign off on runbooks.

Best,

Laura / Rishi —

Internal ops notes and proposed runbook additions to address Olivia's asks. Draft below; I'll convert to the canary checklist and add to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cFintab-capacity

Pre-provision & validation (Day -14 to -10):
- Provision Pool-A (20 GPUs) and Pool-B (20 GPUs) in us-west-2, isolate networking, attach VPC peering per Private config.
- Run synthetic load (3 runs at 60%, 80%, 95% target) using their representative prompts; capture p50/p95/p99 latency.
- Confirm KV-cache priming script runs in <10 min for 50k unique prefixes (we have script version v1.4).

Canary plan (Day -7 to -5):
- Route 5% of non-critical ingestion traffic to Pool-A for 48h.
- Monitoring thresholds (fail if any of the following sustained >15m): p95 latency regressed >20% vs baseline, token error rate >0.5%, throughput drop >12%.
- Alerting: PagerDuty + Slack #fintab-cutover; we will enable verbose logs for 72h.

Rollback / mitigation steps (fast path):
1) Immediate traffic cut: move 100% traffic off Pool-A back to current pool via routing service (expected <90s to take effect).
2) Rehydrate caches only if needed: start KV-cache warmup on primary pool (estimated 6-8 min to reach 80% hit rate).
3) If persistent issues beyond 30m, escalate to model team and consider scaling Pool-B up for capacity while investigation continues.

Read-only routing option: we can set Pool-A to read-only for first 24h by disabling write-affecting APIs at the routing layer; impact: some job types will error if they require stateful updates — need Fintab confirmation on which job types are safe.

Scheduling proposal:
- Pre-provision: Nov 10-12
- Canary: Nov 16-17 (48h window)
- Incremental shift: Nov 18-20

Rishi — can you confirm commercial acceptance and whether procurement will need NET30 vs. quarterly invoicing? I'll package the runbook and send the customer a finalized timeline once you confirm.
